# Anime Manga House (动漫屋) fixtures

`series.html` retains metadata and all 1,022 rendered chapter entries from [山海逆战](https://www.dm5.com/manhua-shanhainizhan1/), captured on 2026-10-25. The catalog preserves ascending order, chapter titles and IDs, and paid-entry locks.

`reader.html` retains the declarations and image container for chapter `521974`, including its 13-page count. Signing values are synthetic. Browser mocks retain the captured signed-response format and first image paths, provide distinct controlled paths for subsequent batches, and return PNG image controls.
